cli.usage:
Usage: model-eval <command> [options]

Commands: init, lint, run, grade, compare, swap, report

Common options:
  --config <path>  Config file (default ./model-eval.config.yaml)
  --json           Write one JSON document to stdout
  --lang <en|ko>   Language of human output
  --verbose        Show adapter stderr and per-stage timings
  --no-color       Disable colour

Without a command:
  --version        Print the version
  --help, -h       Print this help
cli.unknownCommand: Unknown command "{command}". Run model-eval --help for the list of commands.
cli.unavailableCommand: The command "{command}" is not available in this build.
cli.missingCommand: No command given. Run model-eval --help for the list of commands.
cli.invalidLang: --lang must be en or ko, not "{value}".
cli.internalError: Internal error: {detail}. This is a bug in model-eval; please report it.
cli.invalidCount: --{option} must be a whole number of 1 or more, not "{value}".
cli.invalidMaxCost: --max-cost-usd must be an amount of 0 or more, or none, not "{value}".
cli.unknownVariant: The config has no variant "{variant}". Variants: {variants}.
cli.sameVariant: --from and --to name the same variant "{variant}"; a swap compares two different variants.
note.clear-drop-too-few-cases: clear drop, too few cases to decide
needed.repeats: a new run with {repeats} repeats gives this cell {cellTrials} trials per variant (now {currentTrials}) and the whole run {trialsPerVariant} trials per variant; about 80% chance of a verdict (estimate)
needed.nearMargin: near the margin, repeats are unlikely to settle it
needed.cases: repeats cannot settle it; about {cases} cases are needed
needed.on-margin: exactly on the margin, repeats are unlikely to settle it
warning.transient-rate: Transient error rate {rates} is above {threshold}; lower the concurrency if evaluation load causes it.
warning.discard-rate-increase: Discard rate {rates}: the candidate is more than {threshold} above the baseline.
warning.regeneration-rate-increase: Regeneration rate {rates}: the candidate is more than {threshold} above the baseline, so the service filters its first answers more often.
warning.latency-p95-ratio: Latency p95 {p95Ms} ms: the candidate takes {ratio} times the baseline, above {threshold}.
warning.cost-ratio: Cost per trial {costPerTrialUsd} USD: the candidate costs {ratio} times the baseline, above {threshold}.
warning.identical-repeats: Every repeat of these cases returned the same output, so the repeats add no information.
warning.response-model-changed: More than one response model answered within a run ({models}); the model behind an alias changed during the run.
warning.same-response-model: Both variants were answered by the same response models ({models}) although their model names differ.
warning.render-mismatch: Trials whose request differs from the rendered prompt: {trials}. Anchor checks may not match the real request.
warning.abandoned-trials: Trials abandoned without an answer: {trials} (tool time limit {timeoutMs} ms). Failed calls in late responses: {lateFailures}.
warning.resume-config-ignored: On resume the run kept its recorded {fields}; cases only in the files were left out.
warning.unpriced-model: Calls to unpriced models were charged at the most expensive configured price: {models}.
warning.cached-input-unpriced: No cachedInput price, so cache hits were charged at the input price: {models}.
warning.estimate-low-accuracy: Input tokens could not be counted from the render; the estimate uses estimate.inputTokens = {inputTokens}.
warning.conservative-over-budget: The conservative estimate of {conservativeUsd} USD exceeds the cap of {maxCostUsd} USD; the run may stop at the cap if the cache misses or outputs are long.
warning.partial-run: A compared run is not finished: {runs}.
reason.partial-run: Withheld because a compared run is not finished: {runs}.
reason.no-judged-trials: Nothing to judge: no judged trial in {variants}.
reason.baseline-incomplete: The baseline completed only {rate} of its trials in this language, below one half.
reason.no-gate: The gate is empty, so nothing can block.
reason.no-gated-cells: No gated cell could be judged.
reason.rule-not-judged: This gated rule has no judged cell.
reason.dominant-error: {share} of the failing trials end with the same error: {message}
reason.abandoned-in-systematic: Abandoned trials inside the systematic failures: {trials} (tool time limit {timeoutMs} ms).
report.title: model-eval report: {baseline} → {candidate}
report.priorComparisons: Earlier comparisons of these two variants: {count}
report.summaryScope: targets {targets} · rules judged {judged} of {total} · review rules {review} (side by side on the result page)
report.metric.tokensPerTrial: Tokens per trial (input / cached input / cache write / output / reasoning)
report.cellsIntro: Compliance per rule, language and output surface, case-weighted, with intervals. The lower bound of a difference uses the configured level; the upper bound of a gated cell is corrected for the number of gated cells.
report.pooledIntro: Pooled per rule over languages, for reference only; no verdict.
report.noFailing: No regressed cell has failing examples.
report.maskedIntro: Raw cells whose failures the service masked (failed raw, passed final):
report.noPostprocess: {variant}: the adapter declares no post-processing, so the shipped text is the raw answer.
report.lowBaselineIntro: Cells whose baseline compliance is below {level}:
report.lowBaselineNone: No cell has a baseline compliance below {level}.
report.opsIntro: Rates per variant with intervals and counts. Operational metrics do not affect the exit code.
report.scope.review: Review rules (side by side on the result page)
report.scope.changedHash: Cases left out because their content changed
human.swap.header: model-eval swap  {baseline} → {candidate}   {cases} cases ({languages}) · {repeats} repeats · {trials} trials · {spent} (expected {expected} · conservative {conservative})
human.run.header: model-eval run  {variant}   {cases} cases ({languages}) · {repeats} repeats · {trials} trials · {spent} (expected {expected} · conservative {conservative})
human.run.stopped: Stopped early: {reason}. The run is partial.
human.sideBySide: Side by side: {count} review rules, see the result page
human.opsWarning.ratio: warning: more than {threshold} times the baseline
human.opsNote: Operational metrics do not affect the exit code.
human.noComparison.config-error: No comparison: the swap stopped on a configuration error. Fix it and run again.
human.noComparison.nothing-finished: No comparison: no trial finished in either run.
human.stopped: Stopped early: {reason}. Both runs are partial.
human.stop.budget: the next attempt would cross the cost cap
human.stop.budget-projected: the re-estimated total exceeds the cost cap
human.stop.adapter-errors: the adapter error rate passed run.maxAdapterErrorRate
human.stop.transient-errors: the transient error rate passed run.maxTransientRate
human.unpricedCalls: calls to models without a price while a cap is set: {models}. Add their prices and run again.
human.plan.variant: {trials} trials · {calls} calls · {inputTokens} input tokens · {outputTokens} output tokens · reservation {reservation} per attempt · basis {basis}
human.overBudget: The expected cost {expected} exceeds the cap {cap}, so no model was called. Run fewer cases or repeats, or raise the cap with --max-cost-usd.
human.configInvalid: The config, rule or case files cannot be used ({count} problems):
human.start.unpriced-variant: {variant}: the model {model} has no price while a cap is set. Add it to pricing, or run without a cap (--max-cost-usd none).
human.start.unknown-target: {variant}: case {caseId} names the target {target}, which the adapter does not declare.
human.start.missing-lang: {variant}: case {caseId} has no lang, but the target {target} has several languages.
human.start.no-cases: {variant}: there are no cases to run.
human.start.input-tokens: {variant}: input tokens of case {caseId} cannot be estimated without a render; set estimate.inputTokens.
human.start.lock-unreadable: {variant}: the lock {path} cannot be read; remove it if no run is active.
lint.unknown-rule: The case names a rule that does not exist.
lint.input-schema: The case input does not match the input schema of target {target}: {detail}
lint.missing-lang: The case has no lang, but target {target} has several languages.
lint.unresolved-ref: The case has no value at {path}, which the rule needs.
lint.derived-tracked: A derived case file must stay out of version control ({cause}).
lint.example-mismatch: The example "{example}" should {expected} but does not.
lint.adapter-failed: The adapter failed, so the checks that need it did not run: {detail}
lint.anchor-missing: The rendered prompt does not contain "{quote}".
lint.rule-without-case: No case names this listed rule.
lint.rule-filter-mismatch: The case lists a rule whose target or language does not match; it is not graded.
lint.completed-not-gated: Rejections, time-outs and discards cannot block ({cause}).
lint.language-gap: No case covers this rule language.
lint.few-cases: The gated cell ({surface}) has only {cases} cases, so it catches only large drops.
lint.margin-unreachable: The gated cell ({surface}) plans {plannedTrials} trials, fewer than the {nMin} its margin {margin} needs; equal compliance cannot pass.
lint.vcs-unknown: Not a git work tree, so tracked derived cases cannot be found.
lint.helper-outdated: The adapter helper {version} is older than the bundled {bundled}; copy it again with init.
lint.unanchored: No anchor for this rule and language.
